apps/web/src/components/frame/PageScroll.reason: The page-scroll owner's three permanent listeners, installed once at module load like the location store's and never tied to a component: a capture click that turns a link to a #fragment of this page into a glide, the reader's wheel, touch, pointer and key input that stops a glide and ends a #fragment hold, and window scroll, which tells the browser's own scroll anchoring from the reader during a hold. All three are page-wide by nature (any link, any input, the window's scroll position), and the lint knows only the location store and the page-event registry as owners

Starts the in-page anchor glide: a frame-by-frame animation of the window scroll (600 to 800 ms ease in-out by distance) that stops at once on reader input; it replaces CSS smooth scrolling because WebKit cannot stop a native smooth scroll the reader interrupts, so each frame is the animation, not an ordering patch
The next frame of the same anchor glide; the loop ends when the glide reaches its target, the page changes or the reader scrolls
